title: Keto Charred Mediterranean Chicken
description: A flavorful and healthy keto dish featuring charred chicken, kissed with Mediterranean spices, served with a side of bean-free salad.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
Drizzle olive oil over the chicken and rub it in.
Place the chicken in the oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the mixed greens in a bowl.
Squeeze lemon juice over the greens and toss to combine.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
Serve the sliced chicken on top of the mixed greens salad.
Enjoy your keto charred Mediterranean chicken!
